string.value: As I understand, you were unable to find the works of Pappers? To hell with that. Living professor is more important than his papers.
Pick the egghead and bring him to the base. Use force if he resists.
Stop, agent.
You are on infested territory.
No-one has the right to take the toxin out of the place and poison the rest of the world.
Your truck is covered in infection from wheels to top.
Sorry, but I have to kill you.
Our astronomers detected a huge UFO on geostationary orbit.
Pappers is a leading specialist of Base 31, and it was the base researching alien technologies. We need to hear his opinion.
So here is your new mission: return to professor Pappers, pick him up whatever he says, use force if needed, and leave the infected area immediately.
Start the evacuation of the professor. As both air survey and land detectors show, the infestation cloud moves fast in your direction. Hurry, agent.
Don't run, agent. Trust me, you wouldn't defeat me lately, and now you can't, either...
I'm a subject of the mutation, and it changed me, it gave me great strength and power.
But the price was too high. And I'm not letting you drag this Z-120 infection in the world that doesn't suspect anything.
Prepare to die. I hope you see my point, as a patriot to a patriot, because it's our blood that fertilizes the tree of liberty.
You managed… But what is that?.. I'm starting to see everything different.
Damn, I've nearly condemned myself to death! Thanks, agent, your bullets helped me great.
Not that I would ever dared to… I would never even figure it out...
But it doesn't matter, stop the professor, he got it all wrong. He will destroy everyone, every nation, the whole world. He driven the things to a verge of a catastrophe already…
I would stop him if I knew before, but now, when I know, I have no power on it.
Only humans can save the humankind. Kill him before it's too late.
I didn't even think it was possible! One captain was worth a whole company.
Anyway, I'm glad you are victorious. Captain was a patriot you don't meet every day. It's a pity he got the situation wrong.
I propose a minute of silence in his honor.
